A '''Jedi Justice Cruiser''' was a heavily armed gunboat model used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Characteristics==
The gunboat was 68 meters long, but was classified as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==History==
The Justice Cruisers were decommissioned after [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] because the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] feared the Jedi's military might. After being stripped of their weapons, some of these ships found their way to the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] and were considered formidable starships due to the addition of black market weapons.
